termEn: Grid (Interactive Tabular Data or Layout Container)
termZh: 网格（交互式表格数据或布局容器）
definitionZh: 网格小部件是一个容器，使用户能够使用方向导航键（例如箭头键、 Home 和 End ）来导航其包含的信息或交互元素。作为提供灵活键盘导航的通用容器小部件，它可以满足各种需求。它可以用于简单的用途，例如对复选框或导航链接的集合进行分组，也可以用于复杂的用途，例如创建功能齐全的电子表格应用程序。虽然在描述和呈现具有网格角色的元素的逻辑结构时，WAI-ARIA 属性的名称和辅助技术中使用了“行”和“列”这两个词，但在元素上使用网格角色并不一定意味着其视觉呈现是表格形式的。
sourceDefinition: A grid widget is a container that enables users to navigate the information or interactive elements it contains using directional navigation keys, such as arrow keys, Home , and End . As a generic container widget that offers flexible keyboard navigation, it can serve a wide variety of needs. It can be used for purposes as simple as grouping a collection of checkboxes or navigation links or as complex as creating a full-featured spreadsheet application. While the words "row" and "column" are used in the names of WAI-ARIA attributes and by assistive technologies when describing and presenting the logical structure of elements with the grid role, using the grid role on an element does not necessarily imply that its visual presentation is tabular.
